name: PHP2Shell
assessment_limits: An HTTP banner is an observation, not proof of the installed web runtime or its patch status.
Older upstream versions may contain vendor backports. Check the complete package build against the vendor advisory.
An affected build does not by itself establish remote exploitability of a particular website.
Verify the runtime serving web requests; the CLI binary may differ. Confirm patched workers were restarted.
Absence of a PHP header does not establish absence of PHP.

separate_followup.note: PHP's October 23 notice recommends retaining session.upload_progress.enabled=0 pending a fix for this separate issue. Do not use this setting alone to conclude that either PHP2Shell CVE is fixed.
